title: DailyJournal
role: Sole developer: app, API and Play Store release
summary: A journal app on Google Play. Each entry is kept private or shared to a public feed.
body:
A journal app for Android, published on Google Play, where each entry is either kept private or shared to a public feed.

The app is built with Expo and React Native on an Express and MongoDB API with JWT sign-in. It is free to use and carries AdMob ads.

I built it on my own, from the API to the store listing, between August 2023 and March 2024.

highlights.title: Private or public, per entry
highlights.text: Every entry is saved as public or private. Public entries join a shared feed; the writer's own list keeps both, in separate tabs.

highlights.title: Entries with their own colours
highlights.text: Writers pick a background and text colour for each entry, and the feed lays entries out in a masonry grid, six to a page.

highlights.title: Built for a store release
highlights.text: The feed checks for a connection before loading, a banner ad sits after every fourth entry, and a full-screen ad follows a new post. The current release is version 1.2.6.

highlights.title: Moderation and ownership
highlights.text: Readers can report an entry with a reason, and only an entry's author can edit or delete it, enforced on the server.

highlights.title: Account recovery by email
highlights.text: A forgotten password is reset with a five-character code sent by email. Passwords are hashed with bcrypt and sessions use JWT.
